name: omp-dsh-workers
description: oh-my-pi extension that turns the main session into a director of external DeepSeek Harness (DSH) workers: direct dsh_spawn, run events relayed into chat by a script representative, persistent DSH sessions, deterministic steering.
author: ask33r (https://github.com/ask33r)

scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration && bun run test:bridge
scripts.test:unit: bun test --isolate extensions/dsh-task/index.test.ts extensions/dsh-task/dvibe.test.ts extensions/dsh-task/ui.test.ts extensions/dsh-task/ui-render.test.ts extensions/dsh-task/ui-render-v21.test.ts extensions/dsh-task/ui-ownership.test.ts extensions/dsh-task/relay.test.ts
scripts.test:bridge: node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout=25000 tools/dsh-bridge/test/bridge.test.js tools/dsh-bridge/test/async-run.test.js tools/dsh-bridge/test/pollrun-envelope-race.test.js tools/dsh-bridge/test/pollrun-exitcode-race.test.js tools/dsh-bridge/test/send-to-run.test.js tools/dsh-bridge/test/owner-watchdog.test.js tools/dsh-bridge/test/task-protocol.test.js tools/dsh-bridge/test/resume-from-run.test.js tools/dsh-bridge/test/layering.test.js tools/dsh-bridge/test/label.test.js tools/dsh-bridge/test/registry-lock.test.js tools/dsh-bridge/test/pid-identity.test.js tools/dsh-bridge/test/spawn-registry-failure.test.js tools/dsh-bridge/test/model-spec.test.js tools/dsh-bridge/test/model-override.test.js tools/dsh-bridge/test/own-runs.test.js tools/dsh-bridge/test/kill-safe.test.js tools/dsh-bridge/test/bun-guard.test.js
